description: This file contains the 'Review' class for managing product reviews in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving reviews, as well as updating product ratings and handling review statuses.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Class for managing product reviews, including CRUD operations, rating updates, and filtering reviews.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Creates a new review record in the database and updates the product rating.

methods.name: editReview
methods.description: Updates an existing review record and recalculates the product rating.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Changes the approval status of a review.

methods.name: deleteReview
methods.description: Deletes a review and updates the product rating accordingly.

methods.name: deleteReviewsByProductId
methods.description: Deletes all reviews associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getReview
methods.description: Retrieves a review record by its ID, including product name.

methods.name: getRating
methods.description: Calculates the average rating for a product based on approved reviews.

methods.name: getReviews
methods.description: Fetches a list of reviews based on filtering criteria.

methods.name: getTotalReviews
methods.description: Returns the total count of reviews matching filters.

methods.name: getTotalReviewsAwaitingApproval
methods.description: Returns the count of reviews pending approval.
